name: Palo Alto Panorama
description: CRUD automation library for Palo Alto Panorama 11.1.

document.name: List Security Pre-Rules
document.description:
Lists all security pre-rules in the specified device group.

Inputs:
  location     - Panorama location (e.g. 'shared')
  device_group - Device group name

document.name: Create Security Pre-Rule
document.description:
Creates a new security pre-rule.

Inputs:
  name         - Rule name
  location     - Panorama location
  device_group - Device group name
  config       - Rule body. Example:
  {
    "from":["trust"],"to":["untrust"],
    "source":["10.0.0.0/8"],"destination":["any"],
    "application":["web-browsing"],
    "service":["application-default"],"action":"allow"
  }

@device-group.description: The name of the Panorama device group to which you have assigned the firewalls, when `location` is `device-group`

negate.description: Target to all but these specified devices and tags

source-imsi.description: IMSI (14-15 digits) or 6 digit prefix or a range

icmp-unreachable.description: Send ICMP unreachable error when action is drop or reset

disable-server-response-inspection.description: Disable inspection of server side traffic

log-setting.description: Name of a Log Forwarding object

log-end.description: Log at session end (required for certain ACC tables)

x-panMultiple.description: specify codepoint in format of 'xxxxxx' where x is {0|1}
